frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Across its warning derivational family (Form IV verb 'andhara/yun*iru', the participles mun*ir/mun*ar, the fa'iyl agent-noun na*iyr, its plural nu*ur and masdar nu*or), n*r contributes: the agentive advance delivery of NOTICE that a grave/adverse consequence is impending, so the recipient may take heed. It is other-directed (agent -> recipient), forward-looking (before the event), fixed to the negative pole (systematic antonym of bashiyr 'glad tidings'), and does not entail uptake, belief, or the consequence itself. This is REPRESENTATIVE, not the whole root: a small, morphologically distinct, lexicalized VOW class (Form I na*aro + noun na*r/nu*uwr) is co-attested but Quran-internally UNBRIDGED to warning and resists this account.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Across its warning derivational family (Form IV verb 'andhara/yun*iru', the participles mun*ir/mun*ar, the fa'iyl agent-noun na*iyr, its plural nu*ur and masdar nu*or), n*r contributes: the agentive advance delivery of NOTICE that a grave/adverse consequence is impending, so the recipient may take heed. This is REPRESENTATIVE, not the whole root: a small, morphologically distinct, lexicalized VOW class (Form I na*aro + noun na*r/nu*uwr) is co-attested but Quran-internally UNBRIDGED to warning and resists this account.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root n*r overwhelmingly (124/130) means to WARN: an authorised agent (God, messenger, prophet, even jinn) puts heedless people on notice of a coming adverse outcome (a punishment, a fire, a dreaded Day) so they may take heed. This warning sense is broad, morphologically rich, and pinned down by its constant contrast with 'good tidings' (bashiyr). Separately, a small cluster of 6 occurrences uses the same consonants to mean a VOW: a person binds themselves by a pledge to God (a fast, an unborn child, an offering) which is then to be fulfilled. The direction (human->God), the valence (pious self-dedication, not threat), and the collocation (fulfilment, wafaa') are all opposite to warning, and no verse bridges the two. So the root's representative contribution is WARN, with VOW recorded as a genuine resistant lexicalized class rather than forced into unity.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: WARN does NOT entail: (a) uptake/belief/aversion of the outcome (2:6 'it is the same whether you warn them or not, they do not believe'; 54:5 'the warnings availed nothing'); (b) the punishment itself, which is a separate object listed alongside the warning (54:36; the Surah-54 refrain 'My punishment AND My warnings' keeps notice distinct from consequence); (c) glad tidings / positive announcement (systematically excluded as the counter-term to bashiyr across ~15 verses); (d) mere neutral informing (it is specifically alert-to-adverse-outcome, oriented to taqwaa/hadhar). Reciprocally, the VOW class carries NO notice/threat sense and is never other-directed; it is a self-imposed obligation owed to God, defined by its fulfilment (wafaa'). Morphology does NOT police the boundary: the split is lexical (the na*r lexeme), not by QAC form-number, and even the vocalized plural separates the classes (warning nu*ur short vs vow nu*uwr long).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The plural skeleton collides across the two classes with irreconcilable meanings: 22:29:5:1 'wa-l-yuufuu nu*uwra-hum' (let them FULFILL their VOWS) vs the identical consonantal plural at 54:5:5:2 'fa-maa tughni l-nu*uru' (the WARNINGS availed nothing) and 10:101:10:3. Same triliteral, same plural skeleton, two unbridged senses (personal binding obligations vs God's cautionary announcements). The Form-I verb is equally decisive: 19:26:12:1 'innii na*artu li-l-rahmaani sawman' (I have VOWED a fast to the Most Merciful) and 3:35:7:1 'na*artu laka maa fii batnii' (I have VOWED to You what is in my womb) cannot be read as putting anyone on notice of a threat, against warn-verb tokens such as 92:14:1:2 'fa-an*artu-kum naaran talazzaa' (I have WARNED you of a blazing fire). No occurrence sits astride the two senses.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The strongest unifier posits a thin single nucleus: 'a solemn, forward-looking binding declaration concerning a future matter' - warning = declaring a coming consequence to another; vowing = binding oneself to a coming obligation before God; a derivational story could even motivate it (a lost Form I 'be under binding notice' -> causative Form IV 'put another on notice = warn'). It is rejected because (a) it is exactly the vague abstraction that fits everything (promise, oath, prophecy, threat, command) that the contract forbids; (b) NO packet occurrence bridges the senses - the Form-I verb is only ever 'vow' (3/3), the warn-family is never 'vow'; (c) the direction is opposite (God->people vs human->God) and the valence is opposite (adverse threat vs pious self-dedication); (d) the one Form-I-tagged item that could look like a bridge, 21:45:11:1 'yun*aruuna', patterns semantically with WARN (same verse as 'un*iru-kum bi-l-wahyi'), so it is a passive-collapse tagging artifact, not a shared nucleus. The unity account survives only by discarding every distinctive feature actually in the text.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses achieved full 130/130 coverage and converge on the same partition: a dominant WARNING family (~124) and a small VOW class (6), with NO Quran-internal bridge between them. WARN alone is broad (Meccan+Medinan), morphologically rich (Form IV verb + both participles + fa'iyl agent-noun + plural + masdar), and adversarially clean, distinguished by the pervasive bashiyr antonymy and by negative boundaries (efficacy not entailed; distinct from the punishment); scoped to itself it would meet the STRONG bar. But per the contract, a coherent resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE: the VOW cluster is exactly such a class (Form I na*aro + noun na*r/nu*uwr, collocating with fulfilment wafaa', directed human->God). It is not forced into warning; it is recorded as a resistant seam. The plural surface-collision (22:29 nu*uwra-hum vs 54:5 al-nu*uru) is the cleanest demonstration that here same root/same skeleton != one meaning. Hence the representative root contribution is WARN at REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE, with VOW carried as persisted resistance rather than a second forced nucleus or a false unity.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form IV verb 'an*ara/yun*iru/tun*iru/an*ir' = to WARN someone (transitive) of an impending adverse consequence, so they may take heed. Object, when specified, is uniformly negative: a punishment (78:40 'an*arnaa-kum *a*aaban qariiban'; 41:13 saa'iqatan; 92:14 naaran talazzaa; 18:2 ba'san shadiidan) or a dreaded Day (19:39 yawma l-hasrati; 40:18; 6:130 & 39:71 'yun*iruuna-kum liqaa'a yawmi-kum haa*aa').
clusters.classification_rationale: 44 occurrences all form V(IV); every read token is other-directed advance notice of a threat. None means 'vow'. Forward-looking (71:1 'min qabli an ya'tiya-hum *a*aabun'; 34:46 'bayna yaday *a*aabin shadiidin').
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Broad Meccan+Medinan spread; consistently paired object = adverse outcome; efficacy explicitly not entailed (2:6 'sawaa'un alay-him a-an*arta-hum am lam tun*ir-hum laa yu'minuun').

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form IV participles: active mun*ir = 'warner' (13:7; 38:65 'anaa mun*irun'; 79:45 'mun*iru man yakhshaa-haa') and passive mun*ar = 'the one(s) warned' (26:173; 37:73 'aaqibatu l-mun*ariina'; 27:58 'mataru l-mun*ariina'). The warner/warned poles of the same warning event.
clusters.classification_rationale: 20 occurrences all form N(IV); active = agent of warning, passive = recipient of warning. Both stay firmly at the warning pole; no vow sense present.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Agent may be broadened beyond prophets to jinn (46:29 'wallaw ilaa qawmi-him mun*iriina'), confirming the role is 'deliverer of adverse notice', not a title restricted to messengers.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Agent/intensive noun na*iyr = 'warner' (11:25 'innii lakum na*iyrun mubiinun'; 15:89 'anaa l-na*iyru l-mubiinu'), its plural nu*ur = 'warnings/warners' (54:5; 53:56 'na*iyrun mina l-nu*uri l-uulaa'), and the masdar nu*or = 'warning' (77:6). Same negative-pole notice-of-consequence nucleus in nominal channel. Metonymic stretch to 'My warning' at 67:17 'kayfa na*iiri' stays inside the pole.
clusters.classification_rationale: 59 form-N tokens (all form-N nouns except the 3 vow-nouns). 53:56 ties singular na*iyr to plural nu*ur; 46:21 carries Form IV verb + plural in one field. Distinctive fixative: systematic antonymy with bashiyr (2:119; 5:19; 11:2; 25:56; 33:45; 34:28; 35:24; 41:4; 48:8; 7:188).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Internal agent/abstract-message indeterminacy of nu*ur ('warners' at 53:56/46:21 vs 'warnings' at 54:5/54 refrain) is metonymy WITHIN the warning pole, not a second class; it stretches but does not break the nucleus.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: 'i*aa maa yun*aruuna' = 'when they ARE WARNED' - semantically WARN (passive), in the same verse as the Form IV active 'un*iru-kum bi-l-wahyi' (21:45:3:1).
clusters.classification_rationale: QAC tags this passive as form V (verb_form None), but its identical twin 14:52 'li-yun*aruu bihi' is tagged V(IV); both are the warning-sense passive. The form-I tag here is a passive-collapse tagging artifact, NOT a Form-I vow instance. Semantics = warn.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Demonstrates that the QAC form-number column cannot police the warn/vow boundary; the boundary is the na*r lexeme, not the form number.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I verb na*ara = to VOW / bind oneself by a pledge to God to dedicate or perform something. 19:26 'na*artu li-l-rahmaani sawman' (a fast); 3:35 'na*artu laka maa fii batnii muharraran' (the unborn child, dedicated); 2:270 'na*artum min na*rin'. Direction human->God; content = a devotional act, never a threat.
clusters.classification_rationale: All 3 genuine Form-I na*aro perfects mean 'vow'; none means 'warn'. Direction and valence are opposite to the warning family, and no verse bridges them - hence RESISTANT to the representative WARN root claim.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Coherent, morphologically marked (Form I + na*r noun), fulfilment-collocated cluster; internally clean but Quran-internally unbridged to warning.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Noun na*r / nu*uwr (VOW) = a self-imposed binding obligation pledged to God, to be discharged. 2:270 'na*rin'; 22:29 'wa-l-yuufuu nu*uura-hum' (let them fulfil their vows); 76:7 'yuufuuna bi-l-na*ri' (they fulfil the vow). Collocates with fulfilment (wafaa'), never with bashiyr.
clusters.classification_rationale: 3 form-N nouns in the vow sense; distinguished from warning nouns lexically and even by vocalized surface (vow nu*uwra/na*r vs warning nu*ur/nu*or). Irreducible to any notice/threat reading - RESISTANT to the WARN root claim.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: The plural nu*uwra-hum at 22:29 vs the identical warning plural skeleton al-nu*uru at 54:5 is the cleanest same-skeleton/two-meanings demonstration; caps root claim at REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE.

reconciliation.rationale: Verse context ('un*iru-kum bi-l-wahyi' + 'i*aa maa yun*aruuna') and the identically-formed but V(IV)-tagged twin at 14:52 fix it as the warning-sense passive; the boundary is lexical (na*r), not by form number, so it belongs to WARN.

'haa*aa na*iyrun mina l-nu*uri l-uulaa' ties singular na*iyr to the plural nu*ur; both poles (agent vs message) sit inside the warning nucleus via metonymy, so this is internal indeterminacy, not resistance.

adversarial_verification.notes: A full adversarial refutation of a single unified nucleus is not run as PASSED because it does not return zero failing occurrences: the WARN core holds distinctively (bashiyr antonymy, adverse-object, efficacy-not-entailed) but the 6 VOW occurrences genuinely resist any warn-based unification and are recorded. Per contract, when the core holds but some occurrences resist, status is NOT_RUN with the resistant occurrences recorded, and the resistant class caps the result at REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) each achieved full 130/130 coverage and independently reached the same warn/vow partition with no Quran-internal bridge; the aggregator re-opened the packet and confirmed the vow word_refs, forms (V/N, verb_form None), and the 22:29 vs 54:5 plural surface collision.
candidate_root_contribution: Across its warning derivational family (Form IV verb 'andhara/yun*iru', the participles mun*ir/mun*ar, the fa'iyl agent-noun na*iyr, its plural nu*ur and masdar nu*or), n*r contributes: the agentive advance delivery of NOTICE that a grave/adverse consequence is impending, so the recipient may take heed. It is other-directed (agent -> recipient), forward-looking (before the event), fixed to the negative pole (systematic antonym of bashiyr 'glad tidings'), and does not entail uptake, belief, or the consequence itself. This is REPRESENTATIVE, not the whole root: a small, morphologically distinct, lexicalized VOW class (Form I na*aro + noun na*r/nu*uwr) is co-attested but Quran-internally UNBRIDGED to warning and resists this account.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 130/130 occurrences read; WARN object consistently adverse (78:40 'a*aaban qariiban; 92:14 naaran talazzaa; 18:2 ba'san shadiidan; dreaded Days 19:39, 40:18, 6:130); VOW objects devotional (19:26 sawm 'fast'; 3:35 'maa fii batnii'; 22:29/76:7 fulfilled offerings).
layer_attribution.derivation: WARN nucleus is carried across a derivational family (Form IV verb 'an*ara, participles mun*ir/mun*ar, fa'iyl na*iyr, plural nu*ur, masdar nu*or); VOW is carried by Form I na*ara + the noun na*r/nu*uwr. The derivational channels are disjoint (no Form IV vow, no Form I 'warn').
layer_attribution.lexical_class: The warn/vow split is a lexical distinction on the na*r lexeme, not a form-number distinction; even the vocalized nominal surface separates the classes (warning nu*ur/nu*or vs vow na*r/nu*uwr). The VOW set is a coherent lexicalized class of 6.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The pervasive contrast with bashiyr ('glad tidings', ~15 verses) and the intended-effect relation to hadhar/taqwaa (9:122 'la'alla-hum yahdharuuna'; 7:63) are contextual/relational supports that fix WARN's negative pole; they are NOT elevated into the root claim, which is the notice-of-consequence nucleus itself.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Two preliminary structural uncertainties were reconciled to CONSISTENT-within-WARN: 21:45:11:1 (Form-I-tagged warn passive -> tagging artifact) and 53:56:4:2 (nu*ur agent/message indeterminacy -> metonymy inside the nucleus). No warn token was reconciled into vow and no vow token into warn.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The 6 VOW occurrences (19:26, 3:35, 2:270 x2, 22:29, 76:7) persist as an unbridged resistant lexicalized class; this material resistance is the reason the root is graded REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE rather than STRONG, and it is recorded as RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases and counterevidence rather than forced into unity.

hard_cases.reason: Form-I na*artu 'I have vowed a fast to the Most Merciful' - maximally distant from 'warn': no recipient put on notice, no consequence announced, direction human->God, object a devotional act.

evidence_basis.statement: 19:26 'innii na*artu li-l-rahmaani sawman' (a VOW) cannot be read as putting anyone on notice of a threat, against warn-verb tokens such as 92:14 'fa-an*artu-kum naaran talazzaa'; no occurrence sits astride the two senses.

hard_cases.reason: Form-I na*artu 'I have vowed to You what is in my womb, dedicated' - a mother's consecration, irreducible to any warning reading.

evidence_basis.statement: 3:35 'na*artu laka maa fii batnii' is a self-binding pledge to God (human->God), opposite in direction and valence to the God->people adverse notice of the WARN family.

hard_cases.reason: Form-I na*artum 'or you vow a vow' - the vow verb with its cognate object, no notice/threat content.

evidence_basis.statement: 2:270 'aw na*artum min na*rin' pairs the Form-I verb with the vow-noun na*r, a self-imposed obligation to God, not other-directed warning.

hard_cases.reason: Vow-noun na*r 'a vow' - self-imposed obligation owed to God, no warning sense.

evidence_basis.statement: The vow-noun na*r (2:270) carries no notice/threat sense and is never other-directed; it is defined by obligation to God, unbridged to the warning nouns.

hard_cases.reason: Plural nu*uura-hum 'their vows' (to be fulfilled) - the same plural skeleton as the warning plural but the vow meaning.

evidence_basis.statement: 22:29 'wa-l-yuufuu nu*uura-hum' (FULFIL their VOWS) vs the identical consonantal plural at 54:5 'fa-maa tughni l-nu*uru' (the WARNINGS availed nothing): same triliteral, same plural skeleton, two unbridged senses.

hard_cases.reason: Vow-noun na*r 'they fulfil the vow' - collocation with fulfilment (wafaa'), never taken by the warning family.

evidence_basis.statement: 76:7 'yuufuuna bi-l-na*ri' shows the vow class is defined by fulfilment (wafaa'), a collocation the warning family never takes, confirming an unbridged second class.

hard_cases.reason: Warning-sense passive 'yun*aruuna' carries a Form-I (verb_form None) QAC tag while its twin 14:52 'li-yun*aruu' is tagged V(IV); a tagging artifact, not a vow.

evidence_basis.statement: The Form-I tag at 21:45:11:1 is a passive-collapse artifact; the same verse's 'un*iru-kum bi-l-wahyi' and the V(IV)-tagged twin 14:52 fix it as WARN, showing form-number does not police the warn/vow boundary.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The 6 VOW occurrences (Form I na*aro + noun na*r/nu*uwr) persist as a coherent, morphologically distinct, lexicalized class that resists the representative WARN root claim and is Quran-internally unbridged to it; they are recorded as RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases and in counterevidence_refs rather than forced into unity. 21:45:11:1 is additionally recorded as a STRUCTURAL_ATYPICALITY (morphology tagging artifact) but is semantically WARN and not resistant.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: The representative claim (WARN as the root's contribution, with VOW as a resistant lexicalized class) would be rejected if a Quran-internal occurrence bridged the two classes - e.g. a Form IV 'an*ara token that unambiguously means 'to vow/pledge to God', or a Form I na*ara / na*r token that unambiguously means 'to warn of an adverse consequence' - thereby showing the classes are not lexically disjoint.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 6 vow occurrences (19:26, 3:35, 2:270 verb+noun, 22:29, 76:7) tested for any threat/other-directed notice reading; and the warn family (esp. the Form-I-tagged passive 21:45:11:1 and the ambiguous plural nu*ur at 53:56/46:21/54:5) tested for any pledge-to-God reading.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Read each candidate's verse_text for direction (agent->recipient vs human->God), valence (adverse threat vs devotional dedication), and collocation (bashiyr/'a*aab vs wafaa'); cross-check QAC form only as a secondary, non-authoritative signal given the 21:45 mistag.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Morphological form-number is NOT treated as authority (21:45:11:1 shows a warn passive mis-tagged Form I); the vocalized surface distinction (warning nu*ur/nu*or short vs vow na*r/nu*uwr) and the fulfilment (wafaa') collocation are used to control against surface-skeleton false matches such as the 22:29 vs 54:5 plural collision.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a genuine bridging occurrence were found, the two-class reading would collapse toward either a single nucleus (raising scope) or, if the bridge were partial/contested, the root would move to UNRESOLVED / multi-class; absent such a bridge, WARN stands as REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE with VOW as persisted resistance.

reopen_conditions: Re-open if any Form IV 'an*ara/yun*iru token or mun*ir/na*iyr noun is shown to mean 'pledge/vow to God' (e.g. collocating with wafaa' or with a dedicated devotional object rather than a threat), bridging the WARN family to the VOW class.

Re-open if any Form I na*ara perfect or the noun na*r/nu*uwr (as at 19:26, 3:35, 2:270, 22:29, 76:7) is shown to carry other-directed advance notice of an adverse consequence, i.e. a 'warn' reading of the vow lexeme.

Re-open if the QAC tagging of the passive yun*aru (14:52 V(IV) vs 21:45 Form I) is corrected or shown to carry a semantic distinction, since the current warn/vow boundary is asserted to be lexical rather than by form-number.

Re-open if the indeterminate plural nu*ur (53:56, 46:21 'warners' vs 54:5 and the Surah-54 refrain 'warnings') is shown to constitute a distinct third class rather than agent/message metonymy within WARN.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A full adversarial refutation of a single unified nucleus is not run as PASSED because it does not return zero failing occurrences: the WARN core holds distinctively (bashiyr antonymy, adverse-object, efficacy-not-entailed) but the 6 VOW occurrences genuinely resist any warn-based unification and are recorded. Per contract, when the core holds but some occurrences resist, status is NOT_RUN with the resistant occurrences recorded, and the resistant class caps the result at REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE.
